build_cuda_extension_utilslib: build the PyTorch CUDA extension utilslib from utils.cpp and utils_kernel.cu sources using setup.py
run_compute_raydirs_forward: run the CUDA forward pass to compute ray positions, directions, and t-min/max from camera parameters
run_compute_raydirs_backward: run the CUDA backward pass to compute gradients for view position, rotation, focal length, and principal point
review_CUDAExtension_setup: review the CUDAExtension setup configuration including nvcc compile args for sm_70 architecture and c++14 standard
test_BuildExtension_cmdclass: test the BuildExtension command class integration with setuptools for building the utils CUDA extension module
